changelog:
Initial release: Convert Figma or Pencil designs into production-ready frontend code using Feature-Sliced Design and Tailwind CSS v4.

- Converts design files to code while enforcing FSD architecture and Tailwind 4 tokens.
- Works with any modern React-like framework and adapts to presence or absence of optional features like component libraries or RSC.
- Enforces strict separation of layers, reuse of tokens, and alignment with design-system guidelines.
- Includes detailed workflows for Figma and Pencil sources.
- Integrates accessibility and validation checklists to ensure quality and contract compliance.
- Never invents tokens or primitives—always reconciles with project sources first.
